label: sdc02_0010_headbb_01
text: Hmmm? Who do we have here...?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_02
text: I KNOW I’ve seen your face somewhere before!\n...Who were you again?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0010_select_01
text: The name’s [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oooh, that’s right, you’re
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Yes,
yes,
I
know you![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_04
text: Well then. Now that you’re here, let’s get going![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_01
text: Wait! Wait just a moment, Director Cyrano![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_05
text: Oh, hello there, Velly! You’re as lively as always.\nDidn’t realize you were here![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_02
text:
Of course I’m here! As director of this academy,
where else would I be?\c
And do address me more properly while students
are present, would you?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_03
text: More importantly, what are you doing out here?\nI thought we had agreed to meet in my office![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_06
text: Did we? Must’ve slipped my mind![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_07
text: Anyway, what’s it matter? This is the student,\nright?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_04
text: Well, yes...[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she is, but...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, I do apologize, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
You
must
be
terribly
confused.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_06
text: This is Director Cyrano of Blueberry Academy.\c\nAs I mentioned on the phone, he’s interested in\naccepting you as an exchange student.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_08
text: Yep! That’s me—Director Cyrano. Er...did I not\nmention that?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_07
text: One look at our young friend here makes me\nsuspect you indeed failed to clarify that point.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_08
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Speaking of which... Why did you request
M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
specifically,
to
take
part
in
your
exchange
program?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_09
text: Excellent question, Velly! It’s very simple. You\nsee, the reason is...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_10
text: ...Uh, hm. Why DID I put in that request?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_11
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Oh, that’s right! The school trip to Kitakami!
[VAR 0x0100(0000)] met some of my
students
there,
didn’t
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_12
text: Yes, yes, one of them was named Carmine, I\nbelieve! She’s the one who recommended you![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_13
text: Oh, that’s right! My sources told me there was a\nstudent here worth keeping an eye on.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_14
text: I asked around a bit, and you do seem to have\nleft an impression on quite a lot of people![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_15
text: Now that I’ve gotten to meet you for myself...\nyeah, I’ve got a good feeling about you.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_09
text: Oho! I’m glad to hear that, Director Cyrano![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_16
text: I’d just love for you to visit my school! You would\nbe a breath of fresh air, so to speak![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_10
text: Well, if anything can be said about Director\nCyrano, it’s that he has a keen eye for talent.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_11
text: I would be thrilled if you went to Blueberry\nAcademy and got to know the students there...\r\nBut only if you’re willing to, of course.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_12
text: Think of it as a chance to further expand upon\nyour Treasure Hunt![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_13
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I wish I could accompany M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
but
I’m
afraid
I
must
ask
you
to
watch
over
h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer
in
my
stead.\c
You WILL watch over h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer, won’t you?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_17
text: Oh, of course! I’d never let anything happen to\none of your students![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_14
text: I hope this experience leads you to even more\nyou can treasure.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headteacher_15
text: Best of luck to you![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: sdc02_0010_headbb_18
text: Just give me a holler whenever you’re ready to\nhead to my Blueberry Academy![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
